title: Find the Bed
author: Jacob Mianecki
description: If your reading this you're probaly in a closet. But more importantly, your stuck in a some-what haunted house and I can imagine your tired. Very, very tired. I recommend you find a bed and take a nap, that is, if you can find a bed without a GHOST IN IT! HAHA! But seriously, if you don't find a bed to take a nap in, you're gonna die. So I'd get right on that.
